grammar.summary: 本课学习 it 作形式主语与 big enough 的语序。

points.title: enough 的位置
points.explanation: enough 在形容词后（big enough）但在名词前（enough money）：The clock was big enough to be seen from far away. enough to do 结果结构。

examples.en: It is not only of huge size, but is extremely accurate as well.
examples.cn: 它不仅巨大，而且极其准确。

points.title: it 形式主语（时间/距离）
points.explanation: It is less than a minute's walk. it 指代客观情况（时间、距离、天气），真正主语后置。

examples.en: It takes a long time to build a clock like this.
examples.cn: 造这样的钟需要很长时间。
